source_evidence: Player exact 'to the first warehouse it is'. Continued observation of established site, actual keeper visibly takes existing records into rear office, no new conspiratorial reveal or unauthorized V decision. D326~17:00 Orsaven public towpath outside storehouse1. V/Cirren/Fenar together, Mara safely at Copper Hart with coach/four horses. Exact player 'to the first warehouse it is' follows Cirren's suggestion to identify control of joint freight account, authorizes ordinary discreet return 150ft along public towpath, not entry, theft, magic, confrontation or expenditure. Existing two leased storehouses and finite personnel allocation per prep/dm-only/dm-ferry-setup.md @300789a66801d87700502e1499b9cfbb15ff72b4; storehouse1 60x40ft, two20ft loading bays, rear10ft office, south towpath loading doors, north uphill street exit, adjoining10ft landing; storehouse2 150ft away. Same previously observed account keeper gathers his account book and loose receipts from the loading bay and takes them into rear office, seen through open loading doors from lawful public position. Two previously observed armed escorts at entrance remain; normal laborer moving freight, no active search, alert, threat or new deployment. Office door open while keeper works, no claim to see document contents, accessible route inside only with permission or chosen trespass; public uphill street can be used to inspect rear approach if V chooses. Cirren independently offers to ask for freight rates as genuine potential estate business and seek account information through ordinary contact, not commit purchase, promise to distract for theft, or initiate action yet. Fenar attentive, awaiting approach, no automatic Help. No perception/stealth roll for ordinary return and direct visible observation; no forced attack. Exact current V-held original invoice: 'RIVERSIDE STOREHOUSE No. 2 — Received in full: 36 gp. One case fine imported lace. Lot 27, transferred from Storehouse No. 1. For the joint freight account: paid.' Account mark and receipt endorsement present, names not yet identified; no customs certificate on invoice. Prior V successfully took invoice unobtrusively by initial d20 4+8=12/DC15, Knack2 insufficient, Past Life4 independently total16 succeeds; Psi6/6, Past Life2/3. Merchant has not been observed noticing loss, no claim permanent. Prior witnessed cases moved from patched-sail lighter to ferry then lower landing receiver, discreet purse to landing official, cases to storehouse1 and receiver gives payment to account keeper; tracked one case to storehouse2 and independent cloth customer pays36gp per invoice. Coxswain observed undeclared imported lace on some earlier runs; no established higher-level culprit or proof other participants knew about/ordered Quenwood killings. Paymaster holds recorded48gp for Quenwood's eighth pending lawful restitution; notification promised not verified sent. Quenwood conviction/life sentence upheld, asset freeze no distribution. Skiff freed and Meret referral delivered, no new hire. V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP6/7 PastLife2/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 boots +1Shield no concentration; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40 breastplate/Insignia natural+9/1d6+6 base or1d6+8 raging mechanical greataxe unchanged. Purse2049gp8sp6cp, rations21/feed28, LR0/6; no rest or new spending. Crown preliminary invitation favorable recommendation pending royal decision; confidential Kestrel copies complete original custody unchanged; Crown frontier300+1300 contingent; western conditional service-house grant signed not title, Coris300 pending optional800, orders balance520 target353, Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed. V dice delegated. Await V's chosen approach to office/keeper; no action assumed.
